text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (—It felt as though time itself had slowed down.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ââHAAAAAAAHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ――Oooooohhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (――In the midst of that all-out showdown, all that existed within me was a thirst for victory.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (And because that thirst burned stronger in her than anyone else at that fleeting moment... she was able to truly bloom.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No, please――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to lose, I don't wanna lose,
I won't lose———!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I will, without fail...!!
I'm gonna wiiiiiiin!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――SHATTERRR!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(The sound of shattering glass...!?
No, that's not it! This is—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Was that the sound of Chiyono O-san—
breaking past her limits "right now"?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Sakura Chiyono O!
Sakura Chiyono O is closing in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhhh---!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Kh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I can't lose...!
I have to... I have to do this too...!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I will surpass my limits...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(—Without a doubt.
In that split second of our clash, I too truly pounded on the locked gates of my own limits...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(It was surely because I witnessed Chiyono O-san
pushing past her limits up close, and――)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Because standing before her,
I strongly felt for myself that
'I don't want to lose,' and 'I want to win'...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I had no idea...!
To think that such a dazzling realm
existed in the middle of a race...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (If I can step into that realm once more, I know I'll—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Right now... I'm...—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I completely forgot... about my sister...—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I won...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I... I won... the Japanese Derby...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O!! Congraaatulations!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
What an amazing race--!!
Everyone was so awesome--!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardaaan!!
That was so, so close!!
You looked totally awesome out there!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Chiyo-chan.
Truly, congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to you,
I was able to catch a glimpse of that realm...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...
And—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I went to greet Mejiro Ardan
after she brilliantly ran the Nippon Derby—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...I was unable to deliver the title
of Derby Trainer to you."
choice_data_list: Still, you have a great expression on your face.
But you have a wonderful look on your face

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan undoubtedly gave everything she had in the Japanese Derby.
That is precisely why her expression now is so clear and serene.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer,
nothing could bring me greater joy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I had a rather bizarre experience.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As the finish line drew near, an unknown sensation welled up within me, as if the entire world were being enveloped in silence—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of it all, the only things that came through with crystal clarity
were the heartbeats and galloping footfalls of Chiyono O and Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"And drawn by that rhythm,
I knocked upon the gates of my own limits
and caught a glimpse of a new domain..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The response in that moment...
The conviction that I can reach even greater heights
still lingers in these hands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Besides...
even I was surprised, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Until the race was over... I had completely forgotten
my goal of surpassing the trail of light
left behind by my sister.
choice_data_list: ...That's proof you gave it your all against your rival.
...That's proof you gave it your all against your rival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: With my rival, giving it everything—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah... So that was the case...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The two of you are my
irreplaceable friends... and rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It was only because I competed with everything I had against them—enough to make me forget Sister's aurora—that...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Precisely because they competed with everything they had—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I was able to...
catch a glimpse of that dazzling realm...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "For Mejiro Ardan, who has pursued her own running and her own unique 'now,' today's realization will surely be immense."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I, too... was able to feel certain of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, my journey with Mejiro Ardan stepped into a new domain...!
